questions.question: Why was the unusually large vault built?
Does it have a relationship to the lower lamp?

description: Beyond maintenance storage and a heavy iron door lies a large stone vault, with cabinets, locked drawers and mostly empty bays. Its scale exceeds the visible household’s needs. Mother and the seller entrust the necklace to it without explaining why it exists.

sections: Section 20: implemented vault/museum; supersedes the old unimplemented vault note in 5.3
§20: implemented vault and museum, superseding the earlier unimplemented-vault note in §5.3.

name: The Lighthouse Vault
